newsitem.title: USA: Cardinal Health in American Oncology deal.
newsitem.headline: Cardinal Health in American Oncology deal.

text.p: American Oncology Resources signed a prime vendor agreement to make Cardinal Health Inc's National Specialty Services unit the exclusive provider of pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to American Oncology's network of physician practices for five years, the two companies said on Tuesday.
American Oncology is expected to purchase more than $1 billion in drugs and supplies over the life of the agreement, the companies said.

As part of the arrangement, National Specialty will develop an interface between CHOICE-M.D., the company's proprietary electronic order entry and inventory management system, and American Oncology's clinical management software.

The combined system is intended to allow National Specialty to forecast each practice's requirements for drugs and supplies based on the upcoming patient schedule and the physician's treatment protocol and then automatically replenish to anticipated demand.
The parties anticipate that the system will result in reduced inventory levels and administrative costs for both National Specialty and American Oncology.
